question: Can a GET on uploads.github.com tell a working login from a rejected one (SOURCE-QUERY-03 step 3)?
finding: The upload host checks the name parameter before the login, so this GET returns 400 for any login and cannot diagnose the 401. SOURCE-QUERY-03 step 3 was uninformative and is dropped in SOURCE-QUERY-04. A GET with a name parameter was not tried: with a working login it would be an upload-shaped request against the approved draft, which is outside what the owner approved.

expected_answers_for_SOURCE-QUERY-04.note: The draft release has created no git tag yet (draft releases create their tag on publish), so ls-remote should show HEAD and refs/heads/main at a35da44c only.
